hypothesis: A stronger-than-BTC crypto can resume an established uptrend after a 12H pullback into its EMA band. Long positions retain uncapped notional upside during large altcoin rallies. This is the predefined long mirror of the separately completed weak-rally short branch.
single_variable: Mirror the short branch. Require EMA20>EMA50, a completed 12H pullback candle with low touching EMA20 and close above it, then a separate 12H close above that candle's high. The coin must outperform BTC on the trailing 60 consecutive 12H intervals. Buy at the next H1 open; stop at the smaller of the two candles' lows. Same NY post-Monday observation, at most one per coin/week, same native EMA-cloud exit and nine fully collateralized slots. Favor stronger relative return at simultaneous entries.
controls: Matched later bullish observations use the same coin, NY week, direction and entry-relative stop fraction, with the later clock's own relative return. Native H1 stop/EMA, 5bp/market fill, extra 5bp slippage stress; aggregate cash accounting from 1000U. Source gaps, end-of-tape marks, historical censorship and unpaid funding must be counted.
